```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    CNS DISEASE BY MECHANISM                             │
├──────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  PROTEIN         │  Alzheimer's (Aβ + tau)                              │
│  AGGREGATION     │  Parkinson's (α-synuclein)                           │
│  PROTEINOPATHIES │  ALS/FTLD (TDP-43, FUS)                              │
│                  │  Huntington's (polyQ)                                │
├──────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  EXCITABILITY    │  Epilepsy (GABA↓ / glutamate↑)                       │
│  DISORDERS       │  Migraine (CSD, CGRP)                                │
│                  │  Channelopathies (SCN1A, KCNQ2)                      │
├──────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  VASCULAR        │  Ischemic stroke (large vessel / cardioembolic /     │
│                  │    small vessel / cryptogenic)                       │
│                  │  Hemorrhagic stroke (ICH / SAH)                      │
│                  │  TIA (same mechanism, transient)                     │
├──────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  DEMYELINATING   │  MS (CNS — autoimmune; see 07-AUTOIMMUNE)            │
│                  │  GBS (PNS — post-infectious)                         │
│                  │  CIDP (chronic GBS equivalent)                       │
├──────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  PSYCHIATRIC /   │  Depression (monoamine/HPA)                          │
│  CIRCUIT-LEVEL   │  Schizophrenia (DA imbalance)                        │
│                  │  Bipolar (circuit dysregulation)                     │
│                  │  ADHD, ASD (neurodevelopmental)                      │
│                  │  Addiction (VTA-NAc plasticity)                      │
└──────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Protein aggregation diseases share: normal protein → misfolded → seeding/spreading
Psychiatric disorders share: circuit-level dysfunction without overt structural lesion
```

**Systems Bridge:** The neurodegenerative proteinopathies (Alzheimer's tau/Aβ, Parkinson's α-synuclein, ALS TDP-43) follow a propagating fault model that is architecturally identical to data corruption spreading through a distributed system. The misfolded protein acts as a template: it contacts a correctly-folded copy of the same protein and converts it to the misfolded conformation, which then converts more — autocatalytic amplification, exactly as in prion disease. The "prion-like spreading" hypothesis for Parkinson's (Braak staging: pathology advances from brainstem → substantia nigra → neocortex in a stereotyped sequence along anatomical connections) maps to corruption propagating along network edges. The system has no effective detection or quarantine mechanism because the corrupted state uses the same molecule as the correct one — only the conformation differs, and there is no intrinsic checksum. Tau pathology and amyloid accumulation in Alzheimer's are measurable by CSF biomarkers and PET imaging 15–20 years before clinical dementia, which is exactly the silent corruption phase: the fault is spreading, accumulating, and crossing thresholds while the system remains operationally functional. This long presymptomatic window is both the opportunity for prevention (intervene during the propagation phase) and the reason late-stage treatment has failed (the corruption is already distributed beyond local remediation by the time of diagnosis).
